The main takeaway from our work is that
positive scaling vectors can be used to construct reproducing kernels for L 2 (R), but that the resulting reproducing kernels are not projections.
the use of positive scaling vectors can be a powerful tool in the construction of wavelet expansions that do not suffer from the Gibbs' phenomenon.
